challenges.name: order-tracking-timeline
challenges.title: Write the order tracking timeline with exhaustive when
challenges.description: The Cho Xanh app shows one line per order event and the order's current status. The events are a sealed interface: Placed, Paid, Picking, OutForDelivery, Delivered, Refunded and Cancelled. Write describe and status with when expressions that cover every event type without an else branch: cash payments read differently from card and wallet payments, a delivery may or may not name who received it, and refunds never change the status. The test runner reads one event per line and prints the timeline and the status.

tests.name: A card order from placed to delivered
tests.input:

picking

delivered

Paid 245000 VND by card
Picking your groceries
